name: Time zone helper
author: Bulwark
description: Shows the time where the people you write to are: participants' local times in the event form, the sender's local time in a message, a time in several zones for the composer and an optional world clock.

favouriteZones.label: Favourite time zones
favouriteZones.description: Cities or zones, separated by commas, e.g. Berlin, New York, Asia/Tokyo

homeZone.label: Your time zone
homeZone.description: Leave empty to use the time zone of your browser. Set it if you picked another time zone in the webmail settings.

workStart.label: Working hours start
workStart.description: Hour (0-23). Events before it get a warning.

workEnd.label: Working hours end
workEnd.description: Hour (1-24). Events after it get a warning.
